comparison.method: NumPy STFT pitch-class energy; relative-time frame cosine
comparison.limitations: Chroma discards octave, timbre and exact notes. Polyphonic backing and relative-time alignment affect this score; it does not establish melody fidelity or musical quality.

comparisonScope: The matching-duration beginning of the original take; strong-channel resampling. Polyphonic chroma is not isolated lead transcription or proof of exact note/timing preservation.
